run_img2img_generation: run the OnnxStableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt and input image using ONNX runtime
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the pipeline text encoder and tokenizer
preprocess_input_image: preprocess a PIL image or numpy array by resizing to 64-multiple dimensions and normalizing to [-1, 1]
configure_scheduler: configure the DDIM, PNDM, or LMS scheduler with steps offset and clip sample settings for the pipeline
run_safety_check: run the safety checker on generated images to detect NSFW content using the feature extractor and safety checker model
